name: QOSM
source:
You play as Yuta, a 22-year-old guy, and Ayame, a 40-year-old woman who just moved to the US from Japan, in hopes of a fresh start at life. As you settle into your new neighborhood, you encounter challenges and dangers that ultimately lead you down the path of lust. The question is, what kind of paths will they take? What lengths will they go to, to keep their lives safe? What kind of people will they meet on the way? The choices are yours to make!

[From [url=https://mgdgames.itch.io/qosm-a-mom-ntr]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演的是22岁的男性Yuta和40岁的女性Ayame，他们刚刚从日本搬到美国，希望能有一个新的生活开始。当你适应新的社区时，你会遇到挑战和危险，最终导致你走上欲望之路。问题是，他们会走什么样的路？为了保证自己的生命安全，他们会付出多大的努力？路上他们会遇到什么样的人呢？选择由你决定！

[来自[url=https://mgdgames.itch.io/qosm-a-mom-ntr]Itch.io[/url]]
